stem: Which statement is true for a credit card but NOT true for a debit card?

options.label: F
options.text: A cardholder must use a personal identification number (PIN) when making purchases.

options.label: G
options.text: A cardholder will have money withdrawn from an associated checking account when making purchases.

options.label: H
options.text: A cardholder will be charged interest on a purchase unless the balance on the card is paid in full at the end of the billing period.

options.label: J
options.text: A cardholder can use an automated teller machine (ATM) to withdraw money.
